description: Use this when someone wants to know whether a domain name for their website is free, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa. Checks up to three endings (com, es, net, info, org, de, eu) per call; at most one of them is confirmed with the registry, the others are marked as not confirmed. Read only; registers nothing and gives no prices. Limited to a few calls per hour.

ending.description: Optional. One ending to check. Without it, com, es and net are checked.

name.description: The name without ending, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa. A full domain such as panaderia-ruzafa.es is also accepted. Letters a-z, digits and hyphens.

name: comprobar_dominio
title: Check a domain name
